Description: What the server does on start. 'Load latest save' = load the newest save (recommended for an existing world). 'Load specific save' = load the save named in 'Save Name' below (use to swap worlds). 'New game' = generate a brand new galaxy on the server from BepInEx/config/nebulaGameDescSettings.cfg (no save upload needed). TIP: if a start hangs on 'Starting' (Wine mod-load race), just Stop and Start again to re-roll.

Only used when World Mode = 'Load specific save'. Enter the save's name WITHOUT the .dsv extension (exactly as the file is named). Upload/swap save files via the File Manager into the visible shortcut folder: dysonsphereprogram/Save/ (it links to the real save folder hidden inside .wine). Leave blank when using 'Load latest save'.
Server simulation speed in updates-per-second. Default 60 (normal game speed). Lower it (e.g. 30) to reduce CPU load on large factories; raise it for faster idle progression. Valid range 5-240.
Display/scheduling hint only - Nebula does not hard-cap players. Sets the AMP user count shown in the panel.

Advanced: extra command-line flags appended verbatim to the DSP launch command. Leave blank unless you know you need it. Do not put a world/save flag here - use 'World / Save Selection' above instead.
Password players must enter to join. Leave blank for no password (anyone with your IP:8469 can join). Written to BepInEx/config/nebula.cfg.
When ON, the simulation pauses while no players are connected (saves CPU). Turn OFF if you want the factory to keep running 24/7 even when nobody is online.

Enables in-game admin chat commands (/server login, /server save, /server load). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED ON - it is the reliable way to force a save before restarting (clean-shutdown auto-save is unreliable under Wine). Requires the Remote Admin Password below.
Password used with the in-game '/server login <password>' command to gain admin control (then '/server save'). Set this to something private if Remote Admin is enabled.

ON (recommended): replaces steam_api64.dll with the Goldberg/gbe_fork emulator so the server runs without a live Steam login at runtime. Leave ON unless you know you want the offline-Steam-client approach instead. Steam credentials are still required ONCE to DOWNLOAD the game (see install notes).
Steam branch to install. 'public' = current live build. Only change if you need a specific DSP beta branch to match a Nebula version. Keep DSP and Nebula in lockstep (see VERSIONS.md).
Pinned BepInEx (xiaoye97) version from Thunderstore. Default 5.4.17 (Mono, matches Nebula's dependency). Change only when bumping the whole mod stack - see VERSIONS.md.
Pinned Nebula mod version from Thunderstore. Default 0.9.22. ALL players must run this EXACT same Nebula version or they cannot join. See VERSIONS.md before bumping.
Pinned NebulaMultiplayerModApi version. Default 2.1.0 (the version Nebula 0.9.22 depends on). Must match what the chosen Nebula version requires.

Direct download URL for the ORIGINAL Mr_Goldberg steam_api64.dll (self-contained; works under Wine where gbe_fork fails). Default points at a known-good GitLab CI artifact. This DLL replaces DSPGAME_Data/Plugins/x86_64/steam_api64.dll.
